# Summary

<!-- What changed, and why. For data changes, list the slugs touched and the evidence URLs. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Data correction (fonts.json / pairings.json / tools.json)
- [ ] New data entry (font / pairing / tool)
- [ ] Reference or guide improvement
- [ ] Code fix (scripts, CI)
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes with zero errors
- [ ] All new and edited files are pure ASCII (no emoji, no en or em dashes)
- [ ] No invented data: unverifiable values are null or marked unverified
- [ ] License information verified at the font's source URL, evidence included
- [ ] Counts updated everywhere if data was added or removed (README, SKILL.md, MASTER-SKILL.md)
- [ ] No purple styling, capsule buttons, or fake metrics introduced
